conventions.money: Integer cents in computation; JSON prints dollars with up to 2 decimals. A missing paid or reserve counts as 0; a missing component incurred is paid + reserve; a printed incurred with no reserve gives reserve = incurred - paid.
conventions.ratio: round-half-away-from-zero of numerator/denominator to 6 decimals, in integer arithmetic. Null when the denominator is 0 or no claim carries the input field.
conventions.days: Whole days between ISO dates; medians printed to 1 decimal (mean of the two middle values for an even count); p90 is nearest-rank.
conventions.grain: Account (all included claims of all documents of one quote); breakdowns by policy year (year of the policy period effective date) or by code.
conventions.excluded: Rows whose lineOfBusiness is printed and is not WC are always excluded (counted by non_wc_excluded_count). Scenario exclusions apply after that.
conventions.ct: A claim is cumulative trauma (CA LC §3208.1/§5412) when flagged CT, or nature-of-injury code 60–83, or cause code 97/98, or type-of-loss 02/03, or the description says cumulative / CT / repetitive. Post-termination when the date of injury is on or after the claimant's last day worked: the claim's own lastDayWorked when the carrier prints it, else the quote context's account-level date (report 10 answer 1).
conventions.notMeasurable: A metric whose value is null prints notMeasurable with the reason: the missing input (no payroll / no FTE count in the submission context; no last day worked; no litigation flag, recoveries or cause / body-part / nature codes printed; no valuation date), else 'no contributing claims'. Added in 1.1.0 with claim.lastDayWorked.
conventions.fromSummary: ADR 0017 (brief 18): a summary-only loss run prints period rows (counts, paid / reserve / incurred) and no claims. fromSummary: yes marks the metrics computed from those rows (LossRun.Analytics.PeriodSummaries; by-year breakdowns keyed by the printed period label); every other metric is notMeasurable for a summary-only document. Claim-level metrics and the what-if scenario see only claim rows. Added in 1.2.0.

scenario.description: What-if parameters (underwriter-analytics.md KQ2). Applied identically by server and client; the baseline is the scenario with every parameter at its default.

parameters.name: includeNonCA
parameters.description: false removes claims whose jurisdiction is printed and is not CA (CA experience rating uses CA losses only).

parameters.name: excludeCatastrophicAbove
parameters.description: Removes claims whose as-reported total incurred is above this amount (catastrophic / shock losses).

parameters.name: trendFactorBpsByYear
parameters.description: Multiplies every paid and reserve amount of the policy year's claims, in basis points (10500 = x1.05).

parameters.name: reserveFactorBps
parameters.description: Changes every reserve by this many basis points (+1000 = +10 %, -500 = -5 %).

parameters.name: capPerClaim
parameters.description: Limits each claim's total incurred; the limit consumes paid amounts first (indemnity, medical, expense), then reserves in the same order (Variance, Catastrophes and WC ratemaking).

metrics.name: claim_count
metrics.label: Claim count
metrics.description: Number of included claims.
metrics.nulls: Never null; 0 for an account with no claims.
metrics.valuation: As of each document's valuation date; late-reported claims (IBNR) are not on the run.

metrics.name: claim_count_with_financials
metrics.label: Claims with financials
metrics.description: Included claims that carry financials: claim_count less the claims recorded for reporting only (claim.reportOnly; a census-only status or an incident indicator). Shown beside claim_count, so a count is read with both totals (brief 22 Answers 4). Added in 1.3.0.
metrics.expr: count(claim where reportOnly is not true)
metrics.nulls: Never null; equals claim_count when no claim is flagged report-only.
metrics.valuation: As of each document's valuation date; a census-only claim gains financials at a later valuation.

metrics.name: open_claim_count
metrics.label: Open claims
metrics.description: Claims whose status is open or reopened.
metrics.nulls: Claims with no status are not counted.
metrics.valuation: Open at the valuation date; a later valuation may close them.

metrics.name: closed_claim_count
metrics.label: Closed claims
metrics.description: Claims whose status is closed.
metrics.nulls: Claims with no status are not counted.
metrics.valuation: Closed claims can reopen (development reason 3, §B4).

metrics.name: reopened_claim_count
metrics.label: Reopened claims
metrics.description: Claims whose status is reopened.
metrics.nulls: Claims with no status are not counted.
metrics.valuation: Only reopenings printed on this run; a reopening detected across valuations needs two runs (rule S14).

metrics.name: medical_only_count
metrics.label: Medical-only claims
metrics.description: Claims of type medical-only.
metrics.nulls: Claims of unknown type are counted in neither medical-only nor lost-time.
metrics.valuation: A medical-only claim can convert to indemnity later (rule S8).

metrics.name: lost_time_count
metrics.label: Lost-time claims
metrics.description: Claims of type indemnity (lost time).
metrics.nulls: Claims of unknown type are not counted.
metrics.valuation: As printed at the valuation date.

metrics.name: lost_time_share
metrics.label: Lost-time share
metrics.description: Lost-time claims as a share of all claims (national rule of thumb 20–25 %, §B3).
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no claims.
metrics.valuation: As printed at the valuation date.

metrics.name: paid_total
metrics.label: Total paid
metrics.description: Paid indemnity + medical + expense; breakdown by component.
metrics.nulls: Missing paid amounts count as 0.
metrics.valuation: Cumulative paid to the valuation date; paid develops upward.

metrics.name: reserve_total
metrics.label: Total reserves
metrics.description: Case reserves indemnity + medical + expense; breakdown by component.
metrics.nulls: Missing reserves count as 0 (a closed claim should carry none, rule H9).
metrics.valuation: Case reserves set by examiners; no IBNR.

metrics.name: incurred_total
metrics.label: Total incurred
metrics.description: Paid + reserves, all components; breakdown by component.
metrics.expr: sum(paid + reserve) over indemnity, medical, expense
metrics.nulls: See conventions.money.
metrics.valuation: Reported (case) incurred, not ultimate; apply LDFs for ultimate (§B5).

metrics.name: frequency_per_100_payroll
metrics.label: Frequency per $100 payroll
metrics.description: Claims per $100 of payroll over the policy years for which payroll is supplied; breakdown by policy year.
metrics.nulls: Null when the context supplies no payroll.
metrics.valuation: Claims reported to the valuation date over full-year payroll; immature years understate frequency.
metrics.caNote: WCIRB reports indemnity-claim frequency per 1,000 employees (17.8 in 2025); payroll-based frequency is the rating view.

metrics.name: frequency_per_100_fte
metrics.label: Frequency per 100 FTE
metrics.description: Claims per 100 full-time-equivalent employees over the policy years for which FTE is supplied; breakdown by policy year.
metrics.nulls: Null when the context supplies no FTE.
metrics.valuation: As frequency_per_100_payroll.

metrics.name: claim_count_by_policy_year
metrics.label: Claims by policy year
metrics.description: Claim counts per policy year (frequency per policy year when no exposure is supplied); value is the number of policy years.
metrics.nulls: Claims with no policy year are grouped under 'unknown'.
metrics.valuation: Recent years are immature (fewer claims reported yet).

metrics.name: severity_all
metrics.label: Severity (all claims)
metrics.description: Average total incurred per claim.
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no claims.
metrics.valuation: Reported incurred; open claims develop.

metrics.name: severity_lost_time
metrics.label: Severity (lost-time claims)
metrics.description: Average total incurred per lost-time claim.
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no lost-time claims.
metrics.valuation: Reported incurred.

metrics.name: paid_to_incurred
metrics.label: Paid-to-incurred ratio
metrics.description: Total paid over total incurred. Low in old years means reserve-heavy open claims; 1.0 with open claims suggests under-reserving (interpretation only, no published norm, §B5).
metrics.nulls: Null when incurred is 0.
metrics.valuation: Rises toward 1.0 as claims close.

metrics.name: large_loss_count
metrics.label: Large losses
metrics.description: Claims with total incurred at or above the threshold (default $100,000); breakdown at $100K / $250K / $500K.
metrics.nulls: Never null.
metrics.valuation: NCCI 'large' is $1M; pricing practice caps at $250K–$500K (§B5).

metrics.name: large_loss_share
metrics.label: Large-loss share of incurred
metrics.description: Incurred of claims at or above the threshold over total incurred; breakdown per threshold.
metrics.nulls: Null when incurred is 0.
metrics.valuation: Shock losses dominate small accounts' incurred.

metrics.name: capped_incurred
metrics.label: Incurred capped per claim
metrics.description: Total incurred with each claim limited to the cap; value at $250K, breakdown at $250K and $500K.
metrics.nulls: Never null.
metrics.valuation: Triangles and trend are often built on capped losses (§B5).

metrics.name: loss_drivers_cause_incurred
metrics.label: Top causes by incurred
metrics.description: The five causes of injury with the most incurred; value is the top cause's incurred.
metrics.nulls: Claims without a cause are grouped under 'unknown'; null when no claim carries a cause.
metrics.valuation: Repeat causes and escalating medical severity are red flags (§B3).

metrics.name: loss_drivers_cause_count
metrics.label: Top causes by count
metrics.description: The five causes of injury with the most claims; value is the top cause's claim count.
metrics.nulls: As loss_drivers_cause_incurred.
metrics.valuation: Frequency leads severity (§B3).

metrics.name: loss_drivers_body_part_incurred
metrics.label: Top body parts by incurred
metrics.description: The five parts of body with the most incurred; value is the top one's incurred.
metrics.nulls: As loss_drivers_cause_incurred.
metrics.valuation: As printed.

metrics.name: loss_drivers_body_part_count
metrics.label: Top body parts by count
metrics.description: The five parts of body with the most claims; value is the top one's claim count.
metrics.nulls: As loss_drivers_cause_incurred.
metrics.valuation: As printed.

metrics.name: loss_drivers_nature_incurred
metrics.label: Top natures by incurred
metrics.description: The five natures of injury with the most incurred; value is the top one's incurred.
metrics.nulls: As loss_drivers_cause_incurred.
metrics.valuation: As printed.

metrics.name: loss_drivers_nature_count
metrics.label: Top natures by count
metrics.description: The five natures of injury with the most claims; value is the top one's claim count.
metrics.nulls: As loss_drivers_cause_incurred.
metrics.valuation: As printed.

metrics.name: litigation_rate
metrics.label: Litigation rate
metrics.description: Litigated claims over lost-time (indemnity) claims (§B5); double digits signal a trust problem (§B3).
metrics.numerator: count(claim where litigationFlag and claimType = indemnity)
metrics.nulls: Null when no claim carries a litigation flag, or there are no lost-time claims.
metrics.valuation: Litigation is often added after first report.
metrics.caNote: >90 % of recent CA CT claims are litigated; 99 % of post-termination CT claims (WCIRB 2026, §B3).

metrics.name: ct_share
metrics.label: Cumulative-trauma share
metrics.description: Cumulative-trauma claims over all claims (see conventions.ct).
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no claims.
metrics.valuation: CT date of injury follows LC §5412 (disability + knowledge), often long after exposure.
metrics.caNote: CA: CT 16.5 % of all claims (2025) and 26.6–31.6 % of indemnity claims (2024–2025); ~60 % post-termination (§B3).

metrics.name: ct_indemnity_share
metrics.label: CT share of lost-time claims
metrics.description: Cumulative-trauma lost-time claims over lost-time claims — the WCIRB measure.
metrics.numerator: count(claim where ct and claimType = indemnity)
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no lost-time claims.
metrics.valuation: As ct_share.

metrics.name: post_termination_ct_count
metrics.label: Post-termination CT claims
metrics.description: CT claims whose date of injury is on or after the last day worked.
metrics.expr: count(claim where ct and dateOfInjury >= lastDayWorked)
metrics.nulls: Null when the context supplies no last day worked.
metrics.valuation: Post-termination filings fall under the LC §5412 date-of-injury exception.
metrics.caNote: ~60 % of CA CT claims are filed post-termination (§B3).

metrics.name: subrogation_recovery_rate
metrics.label: Subrogation recovery rate
metrics.description: Recoveries over gross incurred on claims with a recovery (§B5 'subrogation effectiveness').
metrics.nulls: Null when no claim carries a recovery.
metrics.valuation: Recoveries arrive late; untimely reporting inflates X-Mods (CDI Peeters, §B3).
metrics.caNote: CA ERP rates subrogated claims at gross incurred x (net / gross).

metrics.name: closure_median_days
metrics.label: Median days to close
metrics.description: Median days from date of injury to date closed, closed claims.
metrics.nulls: Null when no closed claim has both dates.
metrics.valuation: Censored: claims still open are not in it (see open_claim_age).
metrics.caNote: CA CT claims close slower: 22 % open after five years vs 12 % (§B5).

metrics.name: open_claim_age
metrics.label: Open claims by age
metrics.description: Open claims by days from date of injury to the valuation date — buckets <1y, 1–2y, 2–3y, 3y+; value is the open claims with a date of injury.
metrics.expr: count(open claim) group by age bucket
metrics.nulls: Null when the valuation date is unknown.
metrics.valuation: Old open claims carry development risk.

metrics.name: reporting_lag_median_days
metrics.label: Median reporting lag
metrics.description: Median days from date of injury to date reported.
metrics.nulls: Null when no claim has both dates.
metrics.valuation: Unaffected by development.
metrics.caNote: CT dates of injury follow LC §5412, which shortens apparent lag.

metrics.name: reporting_lag_p90_days
metrics.label: Reporting lag p90
metrics.description: 90th-percentile (nearest-rank) days from date of injury to date reported.
metrics.nulls: As reporting_lag_median_days.
metrics.valuation: Unaffected by development.

metrics.name: reporting_lag_over_30_share
metrics.label: Share reported after 30 days
metrics.description: Claims reported more than 30 days after the date of injury over claims with both dates.
metrics.nulls: As reporting_lag_median_days.
metrics.valuation: Unaffected by development.

metrics.name: incurred_by_policy_year
metrics.label: Incurred by policy year
metrics.description: Total incurred per policy year; value is the total.
metrics.nulls: Claims with no policy year under 'unknown'.
metrics.valuation: Each year is at a different maturity (valuation age); apply LDFs before comparing years.

metrics.name: paid_by_policy_year
metrics.label: Paid by policy year
metrics.description: Total paid per policy year; value is the total.
metrics.nulls: As incurred_by_policy_year.
metrics.valuation: Paid triangles avoid reserving-practice distortion but develop more (§B5).

metrics.name: severity_by_policy_year
metrics.label: Severity by policy year
metrics.description: Average incurred per claim per policy year; value is the all-year severity.
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no claims.
metrics.valuation: Trend before on-leveling; actuaries apply trend and LDFs.

metrics.name: paid_to_incurred_by_policy_year
metrics.label: Paid-to-incurred by policy year
metrics.description: Paid over incurred per policy year — the development view of one valuation; value is the all-year ratio.
metrics.nulls: Null per year when that year's incurred is 0.
metrics.valuation: True development factors need two valuations of the same claims (§B5); this is the single-valuation proxy.

metrics.name: non_ca_share
metrics.label: Non-CA share
metrics.description: Claims whose jurisdiction is printed and is not CA, over all claims; breakdown is each jurisdiction's share of claims.
metrics.numerator: count(claim where jurisdictionState present and not CA)
metrics.nulls: Null when there are no claims; claims with no jurisdiction count as CA-unknown, not non-CA.
metrics.valuation: As printed.
metrics.caNote: CA experience rating uses CA USR losses only; separate non-CA rows (§B3).

metrics.name: non_wc_excluded_count
metrics.label: Non-WC rows excluded
metrics.description: Rows whose line of business is printed and is not WC (GL, auto…), excluded from every other metric.
metrics.expr: count(claim where lineOfBusiness present and not WC)
metrics.nulls: Never null.
metrics.valuation: Mixed GL/auto rows on a WC run (rule S20).
